environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' at priority 200 containing a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request query string parameters against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)` with action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in BLOCK mode with no rule overrides. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with a 5-minute delivery interval, and CloudWatch contributor insights are enabled on the WAF logs.

config.logging: WAF logs to CloudWatch, ALB access logs to S3
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
